=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/review_autofix_step_scripts.py:53-55 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "Defer review on Claude capacity" is registered with severity "warning" (wrapper emits ::warning:: and exit 0 on a missing script), but its `if:` is not `always()`, so tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py:88 fails.
  WHY: The contract requires `(severity == "warning") == runs_always`, so tests-promote-stall-and-review fails in CI. A missing script also silently skips the capacity gate, so the step should use severity "error" with ::error:: / exit 1.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2308-2311 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The Defer step's missing-script handler uses `::warning::` and `exit 0`, but it is a non-always() gate and must use `::error::` and `exit 1`.
  WHY: The wrapper shape must match the registered severity, or the contract test fails.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:210-214 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the old exact OPTIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS literal, which omits the newly appended `ai_engine_fallback_report.sh` (scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:92).
  WHY: The assertion fails, so tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails in CI.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:23512-23516 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_review_autofix_workflow_wires_optional_verifier_bootstrap_and_gate asserts the same stale OPTIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS literal.
  WHY: orchestrate-poll shard 3 fails.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:2270-2276 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test expects the "Attempt post-Codex syntax repair" launch line to end `direct-run; then`, but implement.yml now uses `direct-run || repair_direct_rc=$?`.
  WHY: No launch line matches (`('Attempt post-Codex syntax repair', [])`), so static-checks fails.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:3022-3030 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test expects `REVIEW_HEAL_REPORTER_SUPPORT_SCRIPTS` to hold exactly three entries, but review_autofix.yml now adds `ai_engine_fallback_report.sh` as a fourth.
  WHY: The list equality assertion fails.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:979-999 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: self_heal_validation.sh:381-386 returns exit 80 from claude_run_selected, but the `case "${heal_exit}"` block handles only 0 and 1, so 80 falls to the `*)` branch and then a hard-fail. CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT is never set.
  WHY: A capacity wait during self-heal becomes a validation failure. The discover and diagnose sites handle 80, but this one does not.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1649-1654,2293-2300 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge has no exit-80 branch, so exit 80 is treated as a generic llm failure and AUTOFIX_FAILURE_REASON=claude_capacity is never written.
  WHY: "Record Claude capacity wait" never fires, so the PR is not labelled or resumed and the review fails generically.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:503-533,513,1340-1378,1350,2024-2058,2034,2623 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The claude_run_selected call sites (and scripts/workflow_retro_fanout.sh:149-153) have no exit-80 branch although the wait now defaults on.
  WHY: Exit 80 is retried and ends in a hard failure while the pool is gated, where it used to fall back to codex.
- scripts/provider_outage.py:1052-1058,1111-1119 (capacity_resume) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: capacity_resume reads tracker comments once and closes the tracker without re-reading, so a wait marker posted after the snapshot is missed.
  WHY: The item keeps the ai:claude-capacity-wait label, but no open tracker lists it and the sweep ignores it, so it is stranded.
- scripts/provider_outage.py:1027-1034,984-987 (_resume_wait_issue) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The label is removed before the replay comment is posted. If the POST fails, the next pass sees no label, returns "done", and never replays.
  WHY: The issue is stranded with no label and no replay.
- scripts/provider_outage.py:974-980 (_resume_wait_pr) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The result of remove_label is ignored before returning "dispatched" or "superseded".
  WHY: A failed removal leaves the label on the PR, so review_autofix_sweep.yml skips it forever (one reviewer also notes a possible duplicate re-dispatch).
- scripts/provider_outage.py:959-973 (_resume_wait_pr/_resume_wait_issue, capacity_resume) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A None result from get_pr or get_comment (404 on a deleted resource) is treated as "failed" on every pass.
  WHY: The item never reaches done, so the tracker never closes, the poller keeps capacity_wait=true, and Claude judges defer. A 404 should map to superseded.
- scripts/provider_outage.py:350-352,1079-1083 (list_issues / capacity_resume) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: list_issues fetches a single page of 100, so labelled issues past the first page are returned as "done" without label removal or replay. Severity differs by reviewer (nit vs major); the highest is used.
  WHY: With more than 100 waiting issues, the tracker can close while items are still waiting.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:5293-5304,5361-5368 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On exit 80, run_pool_reviewer writes AUTOFIX_FAILURE_REASON=claude_capacity but the slot finishes as `skipped_pool` (fail-open). No `capacity_wait` slot status exists.
  WHY: The review can succeed while the reason stays set. The Record step then labels the PR, and later unrelated failures are misclassified as a pause.
- scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:410-414,476-559 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: summariser_run_attempt returns 80 but the retry loop has no 80 branch. It does a full backoff, then calls opencode_emit_failure_alert and exits non-zero. Severity differs by reviewer (nit vs major); the highest is used.
  WHY: A capacity wait cannot clear within the job, so retries are wasted and a failure alert is sent for what is a pause.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:266-272,2010,2351-2376 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: run_editor_codex_attempt returns 80 but the editor retry loop handles only 78/79. Severity differs by reviewer (nit vs major); the highest is used.
  WHY: Sandboxed attempts are wasted against a gated pool, and a failure alert may fire.
- scripts/ai_engine_fallback_report.sh:216 with scripts/provider_outage.py:1052-1058,1111-1119 (item key kind:item:run) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Item identity uses the run id alone. A re-run with the same run id that waits again while the tracker is open is suppressed by the existing marker and `done` key. Severity differs by reviewer (nit vs major); the highest is used.
  WHY: The re-run's wait is never resumed.
- .github/workflows/*.yml (workflow-level CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED, 15 workflows) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The default depends on the WORKFLOW_PROFILE repo variable. A consumer that does not set the variable can get `true` without an orchestrate_poll wrapper to resume waits. Severity differs by reviewer (nit vs major); the highest is used.
  WHY: Waits are never resumed and the codex fallback is gone, which changes behavior for existing consumers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2293-2422 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Defer step exits 1, but later steps do not depend on its outcome and continue to run.
  WHY: Claude calls and sandbox attempts run despite the deferral, which wastes resources and may trigger fallback behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:162-177 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The "Provider outage probe and resume" step env omits CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED, although provider_outage.py now defaults to wait-on.
  WHY: A repo that sets the variable to false does not get it applied in the sweep step.
- scripts/provider_outage.py:_resume_wait_pr | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Each waiting PR costs several serial reads, and the batched pr_page helper is not used.
  WHY: It adds API quota use per pass, bounded by PROVIDER_OUTAGE_RESUME_MAX_DISPATCH (default 50).
- scripts/provider_outage.py:582-588 (_failure_fields) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The reason lookup for failure_fields is overly restrictive.
  WHY: It may fail to recognize `claude_capacity` in the resume logic, which strands items.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_capacity_wait.sh and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2293-2312 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper exits 0 on a missing script (severity "warning"), so a misconfigured runtime silently no-ops the capacity defer.
  WHY: A consumer on a ref without the script silently falls through to the codex fallback instead of waiting.
